title: Rune Stones
notes: The Tree of Life window is drawn as the tree itself, inside a carved ring: Seeds are leaves along the limbs, Boughs golden fruit, Crowns blossoms at the top, and your class stat's breakpoints are its roots.
Hollows: every route has 3 hollows in the trunk (after 3 Seeds, after 2 Boughs, with the Crown). Opening one costs 1 Tree point; a minor route only gets the first.

Rune stones drop from monsters (carved ones from elites, bosses and gilded chests). Set one in a hollow and it bends every skill of that route: Widening, Lingering, Quickening, Echo, Twin, or an element rune that turns the route's damage into fire, ice, lightning, water, wind, holy, shadow, poison or earth. They come back out in camp.
New Crowns: Cruel Sun (Pyromancy), The Hand Descends and Warden's Gaze (Prayers), Hydrixa's Venom (Venomancy), Conclave and Choir (Spellwright) and Pile of Heads (Executioner's Creed).
Delthius is spoken of as "they", and the Game Guide tells of the Tree as it truly is: in the Realm of the Heavens, carrying the flow of rebirth.
